sources.scope: 本課「兩奈米以下製程架構」的延伸背景。原子尺度沉積與蝕刻的背景導覽；細部機制以另列的課程技術來源查證。 影片並非本課每一道步驟的實拍。
sources.scopeEn: Related background for Sub-2 nm Process Architectures. Background on atomic-scale deposition and etch; use the course technical references for detailed mechanisms. It is not footage of every step in this course.

videos.title: Lam：原子尺度工程時代
watchFor: 沉積增加材料、蝕刻選擇性移除材料，兩者需要搭配。
原子層操作著重循環控制；不可把每一循環必定等於完整原子層。
高深寬比及三維結構使均勻性與選擇性同時重要。
watchForEn: Deposition adds material while etching removes selected material; the processes work together.
Atomic-layer methods use controlled cycles; do not assume every cycle necessarily equals one complete atomic layer.
High-aspect-ratio and 3D features make both uniformity and selectivity important.
videos.scope: 本課「濺鍍薄膜製程」的延伸背景。原子尺度沉積與蝕刻的背景導覽；細部機制以另列的課程技術來源查證。 影片並非本課每一道步驟的實拍。
videos.scopeEn: Related background for Sputtered thin-film processing. Background on atomic-scale deposition and etch; use the course technical references for detailed mechanisms. It is not footage of every step in this course.
videos.titleEn: The Era of Atomic Scale Engineering
videos.originalTitle: The Era of Atomic Scale Engineering
videos.author: Lam Research

videos.captionNoteEn: Captions and translations depend on the source platform. The bilingual points are original academy guides based on official descriptions, not a transcript or timestamped account.
videos.before: 先問：「畫出離子撞擊靶材與原子逸出」需要哪種材料或介面證據？畫出本課與影片案例的共同處及不同處。
videos.beforeEn: Ask what material or interface evidence Sketch ion impact and target-atom ejection requires. Draw the common ground and differences between this course and the video case.
videos.after: 把「量測厚度地圖並計算均勻性」列為查證任務：均勻性公式與取樣範圍需明示。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
videos.afterEn: Follow-up evidence task for Map thickness and calculate uniformity: Uniformity definition and sampling range must be stated. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

courses.summary: 濺鍍薄膜製程涉及跨國材料、設備與量測合作。本課程地圖選用NIST Gaithersburg／CNST NanoFab 園區代表點作為公開研究或設備技術的代表位置。課程練習以公開原理連結圖形、材料與驗證，不宣稱此處為唯一發明地、所有技術的生產工廠或實際機台位置。
courses.summaryEn: Sputtered thin-film processing involves international collaboration in materials, equipment and metrology. The map uses NIST Gaithersburg / CNST NanoFab campus reference as a public research or equipment-technology reference. Exercises connect patterns, materials and validation through public principles; this is not claimed to be the sole invention site, a factory producing every technology, or an instrument location.

history.title: NanoFab 重新向研究使用者開放

history.textEn: NIST announced reopening and described complementary lithography, etch, deposition and characterization work.

courses.connection: 比較相關課程時，逐項追蹤材料、圖案形成方式、誤差與驗收證據的差異；相似原理不表示配方可直接移植。
courses.connectionEn: Compare related courses by materials, pattern formation, errors and acceptance evidence. Similar principles do not make recipes directly transferable.
